question: Why does the spring not match its surveyed position?

resolutions.conclusion: The spring migrates along an opening fault, and has done so at least three times within living memory.

local_knowledge: Marn's grandmother named a year for it. The herders rebuilt the catch basin twice and did not think this remarkable enough to mention to anyone at the University, who did not ask.
academic_hypothesis: A fixed spring, surveyed once in 371 and never resurveyed, since springs do not move. The archive is internally consistent and has simply never been checked against the hill.
notes: The forgiving reading -- blaming the surveyor -- is the wrong one, and it is wrong in the direction the player will be tempted by after Lothal. Being anti-academy is not the same as being right either.
